title: Web character viewer data
scope: The runtime data the 3D portfolio loads: the encrypted character file fetched and decrypted by the Character utils, and the work-item video assets fetched on hover and turned into Blob URLs. Ignore styling, GSAP/three.js rendering, build configuration and static copy text.
hints: src/components/Character/utils/decrypt.ts fetches a URL, loads the bytes and decrypts them with AES-CBC.
src/components/Character/utils/character.ts fetches /models/character.enc and hands the decrypted bytes to GLTFLoader through a Blob URL.
src/components/WorkImage.tsx fetches src/assets/<video> on hover and creates a Blob URL for the video element.
There is no database, API server or persistence layer in this slice.
rubric: The two file fetches are inputs; decrypt and Blob URL creation are transformations. Blob URLs and decrypted ArrayBuffers live in memory and are not durable storage, so a map with no storage is correct. Penalize maps that invent an API, a database or a queue, and maps that model React components or CSS as contracts.
